「Sakura Dungeon」は、ビジュアルノベル要素を併せ持つダンジョン探索型RPGです。読解と探索が主要なアクティビティであり、主人公は仲間を率いて階層を進み、敵や宝物に対処します。

物語は軽度のファンタジー的対立を提示します。多くの展開は戦闘間の対話で提示されます。物語の深度は限定的ですが、章ごとの進行テンポは安定しています。

アートは明瞭かつ表情豊かなキャラクターポートレートと敵デザインが特徴です。背景はダンジョン通路やキャンプシーンを描写します。アセットの反復は確認できますが、探索前提の構造として機能的です。

音楽は探索中に控えめなループを形成します。戦闘時は単純な緊張感を付与します。効果音は基礎的で、全体として音響演出は最小限です。

ゲームプレイはターン制戦闘です。プレイヤーはタイル状マップを探索し、モンスターと交戦し、仲間を捕獲し、装備を管理します。進行は段階的であり、装備を適切に更新すれば難度は穏当です。

作品のトーンは軽快で、ややフレンドリーな要素を含みます。ドラマ性は限定的です。探索の性質上、プレイ時間は長くなりがちです。

総括として「Sakura Dungeon」は、ビジュアルノベル的な枠組みを備えた素直なダンジョンクロウル体験を求めるユーザーに適しています。予測可能な進行、馴染みあるアート、簡易なパーティマネジメントを提供します。

Sakura dungeon is, contrary to other know titles in the Sakura series from Winged Coud, a Dungeon Crawler.

It has a very interesting story and nice build-up, peaceful music, mostly flute, and a good amount of very beautiful CGs.
The story talks about a past dungeon lord being unsealed again from Ceri, a human Knight girl. Though she tried to defeat the ex-dungeon lord she was defeated and made a subordinate by the lord, which is a fox spirit.  Through the quest to reconquer the dungeon lord and to find out who sealed the fox, we recruit all kind of monsters and allies to fight powerful foes.

This dungeon crawler is a very neat one in i am positively impressed by it an also possess a great story.  The part i find could have be a little bit better is a better change of scenery inside the dungeon, as while exploring through the dungeon, the walls felt just like mirrors, everything looking way to identical. 
And as with most previous titles, i also find a lack of variety of character shapes. Aside from monster type most  characters had the same breat size, same body corpulences with no variety, which i wish would change a bit too in the Winged Cloud series. 
On a side note, 2 of the achievements seem to be not working properly as they dont get assigned after achieving the required event.

Overall I can only recommend this crawler further, and I had hoped to have more evolution with Silvy, the elve, which sadly didn't happen. Though the game still has room to have sequels within the story and I hope to see it come too.

[h1]Reseña de \Sakura Dungeon\: Un Dungeon Crawler para los Fans de la Estética Anime[/h1]

[h2]Resumen[/h2]
¿Listos para la aventura pero con una buena dosis de ojos gigantes y escasos de tela? \Sakura Dungeon\ es el título que pregunta, ¿por qué no mezclar un poco de fanservice con las clásicas exploraciones de mazmorras? Acompaña a una zorra espiritual vieja e inconformista mientras reclutas un ejército de chicas monstruo y exploras las profundidades inexploradas, encontrando oponentes que, sorpresa, también son principalmente chicas en atuendos creativos.

[h2]Aspectos Importantes e Interesantes[/h2]
- [b]Reclutamiento de personajes:[/b] Puedes capturar ‘monstruas’ (que son principalmente otras chicas en disfraces lite de monstruo) y agregarlas a tu equipo. Porque, ¿en qué otro juego reclutas a tus enemigos después de derrotarlos con constantes guiños seductores?
- [b]Exploración de mazmorras:[/b] El juego viene con mazmorras generadas aleatoriamente que mantienen el interés, aunque a veces te preguntas si este calabozo tiene fin o si está en bucle eterno.
- [b]Arte y estilo:[/b] Estilo visual bien ejecutado que grita 'anime' en cada pixel, ideal si disfrutas de vistas llenas de color y características exageradas.

[h2]Aspectos por Mejorar[/h2]
- [b]Diversidad en elementos de juego:[/b] Más variedad en términos de gameplay, porque aunque luchar en panties puede ser un selling point, a veces quisieras más que eso.
- [b]Historia más envolvente:[/b] La trama es algo genérica y podría beneficiarse de giros más impredecibles y menos clichés. Podrían explotar mucho más este divertidísimo universo sin recurrir solo al encanto visual.

This game is basically if you took the concept of is it wrong to pick up girls in a dungeon, had the collect them all aspect similar to pokemon, combined it with a visual novel, and made it a yuri hentai dungeon crawler with battle strip mechanics. I was going to play through this without the R18 patch, but the succubus orb wasn't given to me without adding it, and I wanted to make sure nothing affected the 100% completion. ****Make sure you play the game on the beta branch in order to get all achievements as some are bugged unless played through the beta branch****

That being said, I was honestly surprised, as this game actually has some damn good CG's. The art, the intimacy are all good, but as with any sakura style game, there is a very distinct art style, which ends up making the characters look pretty much the same. Sure they're different monster girls, different outfits, different color schemes, but the nudity doesn't have much variance.

In terms of gameplay I have a few complaints especially in regard to the 100%ing: 
Let shiny lures stack. Shiny lures are extremely necessary in the latter half of the game in order to get the 5000 enemies killed achievement. Even with those being applied every 100 steps, it took hours for me to finish the game once I actually had already beaten everything else. Being able to use them all and have the 100 steps stack would be nice to speed things up.
Auto battle/Skip battle should stay on once activated. Having to reactivate it every time you enter a fight is quite ridiculous, especially considering you see 1-3 enemies per fight (unless its a special encounter in the story) which makes it very tedious for the 5000 enemy kills. You gotta do it damn near 2000 times..
